name: _Send Email Message
purpose: Private API script that sends one e-mail through an SMTP server: takes an EmailMessage JSON, fills missing SMTP settings from the System record (when UseSystemSmtpSettings) or from the user profile with fallback to System, validates required parts, sends with Send Mail and returns Sent true or an error. The incoming parameter is logged as the transaction payload with the password replaced by <removed>. Nothing is stored about the message.

User::SmtpServer#114, User::SmtpServerAuthentication#115, User::SmtpServerEncryptionType#116, User::SmtpServerPort#117 (steps 85-88)
User::SmtpEmailAddress#111, User::SmtpFullName#112, User::SmtpPassword#118, User::SmtpUserName#113 (step 89)
System::SystemEmailSmtpServer#48, System::SystemEmailSmtpServerPort#49, System::SystemEmailSmtpServerEncryptionType#50, System::SystemEmailSmtpServerAuthentication#51 (steps 85-88, fallback)
System::AsJson#46 (via called script Get System, step 77)
writes: DBTransactions::UserId#64 (Set Field step 84, current record; points the User relationship at the sender)

karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/28 "Start Transaction ( TransactionPayload )" (step 54; Perform Script)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/502 "Get System" (step 77; Perform Script)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/29 "Save Transaction Result ( {result} )" (step 177; Perform Script)

Send Mail (step 160; SMTP, TLS, plain password authentication, with attachments from $Attachments)

open_question: secret: SMTP password handled at steps 79 (System SystemEmailAccountPassword), 89 (User::SmtpPassword), 103 (required) and 160 (Send Mail). Payload logging strips Password only at the top-level key scriptParameter.Password (steps 50-52); the System-defaults password is merged later and is not in the logged payload. $From is built at step 135 but Send Mail uses Name and Email Address instead. The built $emailMessage object (steps 144-153) is used only as error context. The password is validated as required even when the SMTP server does not need authentication.
